name: Design Diary
source:
Design Diary is a silly visual novel game about HCI and UX! What seems to be an ordinary day at The Ohio State University becomes strange when your tech starts coming to life... using the knowledge you've gained from COMM 3545, it's time to make things normal again while helping out a new friend!

[From [url=https://pandapartyart.itch.io/design-diary]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Design Diary》是一部以人机交互和用户体验为主题的搞怪视觉小说！在俄亥俄州立大学，看似平凡的一天突然变得古怪起来：你的科技设备竟然活了过来……是时候运用COMM 3545课程中学到的知识，一边帮助新朋友，一边让一切恢复正常了！

（摘自[url=https://pandapartyart.itch.io/design-diary]itch.io[/url]）
